updates.title: Establishment of Class E Airspace; Havana, IL
updates.summary: This action corrects a notice of proposed rulemaking (NPRM) that the FAA published in the Federal Register on August 10, 2026, proposing to establish Class E airspace at Havana, IL. Subsequent to publication, it was discovered that the NPRM was published with the wrong docket number used in two instances. This action corrects those typographic errors.
